intro.headline: About Us
intro.body: RenovationX is a team of designers and craftsmen specializing in high-end residential renovations. We are driven by a passion for clean lines, natural materials, and livable design. Our approach combines creative vision with technical precision — every project is a personal collaboration from the first sketch to the final build.

hero.headline: Our Expertise
hero.desc: From concept to construction — a full suite of renovation services under one roof.

kitchen.headline: Kitchen Remodel
kitchen.desc: The kitchen is the heart of the home. We design and build kitchens that balance beauty and function — custom cabinetry, stone countertops, curated hardware, and intelligent layouts that make cooking a pleasure.

bathroom.headline: Bathroom Remodel
bathroom.desc: We transform bathrooms into serene retreats. Whether a primary suite spa, a sleek guest bath, or a powder room that makes a statement — our bathroom renovations combine luxury materials with timeless design.

fullHome.headline: Full Home Renovation
fullHome.desc: Complete home transformations that reimagine the entire space. We handle everything — design, permitting, construction, and the final walk-through — delivering a cohesive result that feels like a brand new home.

outdoor.headline: Outdoor & Patio
outdoor.desc: Arizona's climate begs for exceptional outdoor living. We design and build outdoor spaces that extend your home into the desert landscape — covered patios, outdoor kitchens, pools, and desert-inspired landscaping.

viz.headline: 3D Visualization
viz.desc: See your renovation before construction begins. Our photorealistic 3D renderings let you explore every detail — materials, finishes, lighting, and layout — so you can make confident decisions with complete clarity.

s1.title: Discovery
s1.desc: We meet to understand your goals, timeline, and budget. No pressure, just conversation.

s2.title: Design
s2.desc: Our team creates detailed designs and 3D visualizations so you can see the future before it's built.

s3.title: Planning
s3.desc: We handle all permitting, material procurement, and scheduling. Every detail is mapped.

s4.title: Build
s4.desc: Skilled craftsmen execute the work with precision. We maintain quality control at every stage.

s5.title: Handover
s5.desc: A thorough walk-through ensures every detail is perfect. Your new space is ready to enjoy.

cta.headline: Start your renovation today
cta.desc: Schedule a free consultation and let's talk about transforming your space.
